title: lightweight-authoring-playbook-adapter-kitchen-quickstart
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Add a compact authoring playbook quickstart that shows adapter-first RAG wiring, local devcontainer, and lightweight telemetry probes for iterative evals.
description: Motivation: teams building retrieval-augmented agents often need a compact, low-friction example that ties together source adapters, a small orchestrator, and authoring workflows. This PR adds a lightweight "authoring playbook" quickstart that demonstrates: 1) adapter-first retrieval adapters (S3, sqlite chunk store, and a memory shim), 2) a minimal RAG orchestrator (node-based runner with explicit tool-binding), 3) live authoring devcontainer for prompt iteration, and 4) telemetry probes (span and token counters) that integrate with the Console SDK. The intent is a small, copy-pasteable starting point for product teams and platform engineers to prototype an authoring loop.

notes: Playbook design: adapter-first so teams can swap backends without touching runner logic.
Security: examples avoid real credentials; README documents KMS/HSM integration patterns for private deployments.
Telemetry: probes are intentionally minimal (span, token_count, retrieval_latency) to keep sample dashboards useful out-of-the-box.
Performance: local indexer uses sqlite chunker for small corpora; for production we link to the indexer profiles in ENG-9341.
